facts.statement: Nebulasaurus is known only from a single fossil specimen, the holotype braincase labeled LDRC-v.d.1.
facts.quote: It is known only from the holotype braincase LDRC-v.d.1.

facts.statement: The genus Nebulasaurus was described and named by Lida Xing, Tetsuto Miyashita, Philip J. Currie, Hailu You, and Zhiming Dong in 2015.
facts.quote: Nebulasaurus was described and named by Lida Xing, Tetsuto Miyashita, Philip J. Currie, Hailu You, and Zhiming Dong in 2015

facts.statement: The name Nebulasaurus means "misty cloud lizard," combining the Latin word for misty cloud with the Greek word for lizard to reference the meaning of Yunnan.
facts.quote: The genus name Nebulasaurus, means "misty cloud lizard", and is derived from the Latin word nebulae meaning "misty cloud", a reference to "Yunnan" which means "southern misty cloudy province" and the Greek word "sauros" (σαυρος) meaning "lizard"

facts.statement: Nebulasaurus lived during the early Middle Jurassic in the Zhanghe Formation of Yunnan Province, China.
facts.quote: Nebulasaurus is an extinct genus of basal eusauropod dinosaur known from the early Middle Jurassic Zhanghe Formation (Aalenian or Bajocian stage) of Yunnan Province, China.

facts.statement: The fossil was found in terrestrial sediments deposited between 174 and 168 million years ago during the Aalenian and Bajocian stages.
facts.quote: The specimen was collected in terrestrial sediments deposited during the Aalenian and Bajocian stages of the Jurassic period, approximately 174 to 168 million years ago.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis identifies Nebulasaurus as a sister taxon to the African dinosaur Spinophorosaurus.
facts.quote: A phylogenetic analysis found Nebulasaurus to be a sister taxon to Spinophorosaurus from the Middle Jurassic of Africa.

facts.statement: Nebulasaurus is classified as a basal eusauropod, though its braincase resembles those of more advanced neosauropods.
facts.quote: Nebulasaurus was classified as a basal eusauropod, however its braincase bears resemblance to those of more derived neosauropods.

facts.statement: The only recovered fossil material is a braincase that was in good state of preservation.
facts.quote: The only fossil material recovered was a braincase, which was in a good state of preservation.

facts.statement: Nebulasaurus is distinguished by exoccipitals that nearly exclude the supraoccipital from the foramen magnum, which forms less than one-tenth of the margin.
facts.quote: the exoccipitals are nearly excluding the supraoccipital from the foramen magnum (supraoccipital forms less than a tenth of the margin of the foramen magnum)

facts.statement: The Zhanghe Formation contains a diverse fauna including the basal sauropodomorph Yunnanosaurus youngi and two other basal eusauropods.
facts.quote: The Zhanghe Formation has produced the remains yielded one basal sauropodomorph Yunnanosaurus youngi, and two basal eusauropods Eomamenchisaurus yuanmouensis and Yuanmousaurus jiangyiensis.

facts.statement: The diverse sauropodomorph fauna of the Middle Jurassic in Asia preceded the dominance of mamenchisaurids seen in East Asia during the Late Jurassic.
facts.quote: This diverse sauropodomorph faunal collection from the Middle Jurassic of Asia preceded the mamenchisaurid dominance that is observed in East Asia during the Late Jurassic.

rejected.quote: The specific name ''taito'', was given in honor of Japanese company Taito, which funded the field project and is geographically near the discovery site.
